text:
maya_ng: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's KV-cache flapping / OOM cluster event. I'm laying out a short action list and owners so we can close the loop. please ack and add ETAs if different from what's below.

igor_petrov: ack. can you call out which clusters/shards had the repeat flaps vs single-event OOMs?

sophie_leaf: i pulled the profiler for shard set A (a1,a2) and B (b3). pattern: steady tiny allocs in slab arenas + fragmentation spikes around 45–75s under 5k rps. b3 had a retry storm that amplified residency.

liam_k: i saw the same in host logs — ephemeral growth not freed until full GC. eviction policy didn't trigger because residency counters were under threshold.

maya_ng: summary action items (initial):
- profiling deep-dive + heapwalks (sophie_leaf) — collect pprof, heap dump, and slab histo; ETA Fri 03/27
- GC/eviction tuning (liam_k) — try reduced max_live_fraction, earlier eviction watermark, and minor compaction; ETA Mon 03/30
- short-term guardrail: shard soft limits + request backpressure (igor_petrov) — config change + canary rollout; ETA Wed 03/25
- postmortem doc + recurring incident pattern analysis (maya_ng) — correlate with deployment windows/traffic surges; ETA Tue 03/24

igor_petrov: i'll own the soft limit canary. plan: add a soft limit at 85% residency, drop new prefixed entries, and return 503 with Retry-After when soft-limit hits. will run canary on b3 then a2.

liam_k: for GC tuning i'll test: max_live_fraction=0.55, minor_compact_interval=30s, and force-scan-interval=10m in staging. also add diagnostic heap export on OOM.

sophie_leaf: attaching quick repro commands (staging):
```
# run microbench with blob churn
./kv-load --shard b3 --rate 5k --key-dist exp --payload 1k --duration 10m
pprof http://staging-b3:6060/debug/pprof/heap > heap_b3.pb
```
I'll upload pprof summaries to the postmortem doc.

maya_ng: also adding 2 operational mitigations:
- short term: enable per-shard eviction hysteresis to avoid simultaneous GC clumps
- medium term: add residency drift alert that fires on 3x baseline increase over 10m

eng-oncall: noted. i'm scheduling a 30-min sync for Fri 08:30 PT to review profiling output and decide on the canary parameters.

liam_k: question — do we have enough telemetry to know whether fragmentation comes from allocation size growth vs retained metadata? sophie, can pprof show object lifetime distribution for slab bins?

sophie_leaf: yes — pprof + slab histo should. i'll produce a short table of top-5 alloc sites and their survivors.

maya_ng: good. one more ask: whoever owns the patch, please include a rollback plan and a fallback model variant (smaller model / lower KV cache usage) if the canary increases latency.

igor_petrov: ack — will include a config flag gate and gradual percentage ramp. rollback script ready.

liam_k: quick note: if compaction increases CPU significantly, we should prefer stage-based compaction (off-peak) unless it reduces OOM rate by >60%. will report CPU delta in tests.

maya_ng: thanks team. i'll update the postmortem doc with these owners + ETAs and tag follow-ups for next week.

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled a config canary for b3 at 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z — tracked under #deploys/kv-canary-2712345678

igor_petrov: acked. i'll post a short checklist in the doc before rollout. please add any extra checks (metrics to watch: residency_pct, slab_frag_ratio, full_gc_count, p99_latency). :eyes:
